versions.changelog:
- Added alternative way to send the buyer key as an HTTP header for improved security.
- Clarified that all 2xx responses indicate success, with exact upstream status codes passed through.
- Expanded the 502 pay_failed case with more detailed refund and retry guidance.
- Updated setup and key handling instructions for improved security and clarity.
- Minor language and formatting improvements for better readability.

Initial release — Merktop Wallet skill v1.0.0

- Pay for x402-gated APIs or resources using a non-custodial Merktop wallet on Base.
- Enforces a hard on-chain spend cap; funds stay in the user’s wallet until needed.
- Buyer keys and budgets set per user; skill cannot spend beyond user-defined limits.
- Includes examples for GET and POST payments via the Merktop pay-proxy.
- Returns relevant outcome codes and headers, including exact cost per call.
- Option to get paid for your own resources via hosted paywalls.
